datasheet_identity.title: MM3Z2V0 THRU MM3Z75 SURFACE MOUNT ZENER DIODES

extraction_notes: Zener-voltage range is 3.1 V minimum, 3.3 V nominal, and 3.5 V maximum at IZT = 5 mA and TA = 25 degC; the schema records the nominal typical value as breakdown_voltage.
Maximum zener impedance is 95 ohm at IZT = 5 mA; maximum knee impedance is 1000 ohm at IZK = 0.5 mA, both from p. 2.
The datasheet publishes no reverse-recovery-time value.
The p. 3 zener, forward-voltage, and leakage plots are family-characteristic figures without a legend or unambiguous MM3Z3V3-specific trace; no target-specific curve points were recorded.
The p. 4 capacitance plot begins at nominal zener voltage 4 V, so it does not provide a usable MM3Z3V3 point at nominal 3.3 V.
Temperature coefficient for MM3Z3V3 is -3.5 to 0 mV/degC at IZTC = 5 mA, p. 2; this field is not represented by the strict schema.
omission_reason: No target-specific usable curve points were recorded: the datasheet plots are family-wide characteristic figures with no legend identifying the MM3Z3V3 trace, and the capacitance plot starts at nominal VZ = 4 V, above this part's 3.3 V nominal voltage.
